caption:
Swipe to see how 3 low-cost AI tools build a complete game character from scratch: character design, movement, and a cinematic video clip, step by step. 🎮

Slide 2 shows the full output, a cinematic game character clip built in 3 hours for $0. Slide 3 covers Midjourney with the exact prompt to get a studio-quality character design in 40 seconds. Slide 4 is the cost reality check. Slide 5 covers Viggle AI, the tool that gives your still character actual movement. Slide 6 covers Kling 2.5, the free video generator that renders the final cinematic clip. Slide 7 is the recap to save.

Game studios, indie creators, and brand designers are running this same workflow to prototype characters without hiring artists. What once took a team and a real budget now takes one person an afternoon.
